text:
maria_sales: FYI AcmeCorp POC is stuck creating the Dedicated reservation in eu-north1, they can’t get a GPU pool bound to the reservation. anyone free to help?
alan_se: adding @jen_infra and the ops bot. what error are they seeing?
chris_cust: when we call create-reservation it returns success but allocation fails when we start instances. UI shows pool in eu-north1 but nodes show 'zone mismatch' in logs. we ran this config: 
```yaml
reservation:
  name: acme-eu-poc
  region: eu-north1
  azAffinity: eu-north1-b
  gpu_type: a100
  count: 4
```
jen_infra: can you paste the pool id and the exact error from the agent logs? also which VPC/subnet are you using?
chris_cust: pool id rsv-0a12b3c4, subnet: svc-eu-north1-01 (AZ: eu-north1-a). Error from controller: 
```
ProvisionJob(rsv-0a12b3c4) failed: ReservationMismatchError: requested AZ eu-north1-b not available in subnet svc-eu-north1-01 (available: [eu-north1-a])
```
ops_bot: @jen_infra - quota check: GPUs in eu-north1-b are at 0 free units for ai-gpu-a100.
jen_infra: ok looks like AZ affinity in reservation is eu-north1-b but customer's subnet is in eu-north1-a. two options: 1) create reservation with azAffinity matching customer's subnet, 2) provision a subnet in eu-north1-b, or 3) create reservation with azAffinity: ANY and let scheduler pick.
alan_se: will changing azAffinity affect pricing or the reserved billing? customer is asking.
jen_infra: no pricing change — reserved capacity billing applies at region level for Dedicated reservations. AZ affinity is a placement hint only. switching to ANY avoids AZ mismatch but may fail if region-wide capacity is exhausted.
chris_cust: is there a hotfix to move the existing reservation to ANY without recreating? we want minimal downtime.
jen_infra: we don't support editing azAffinity for an active reservation. we can create a new reservation (rsv-0d9e8f7g) with azAffinity: ANY and then update the pool to point to the new reservation id. steps: 
```
# create reservation (example)
redwood-cli reservations create --name acme-eu-poc-2 --region eu-north1 --az-affinity ANY --gpu-type a100 --count 4
# update pool to use new reservation
redwood-cli pools update rsv-0a12b3c4 --reservation-id rsv-0d9e8f7g
```
jen_infra: note: if region capacity is tight the pool may fall back to queued state until capacity frees up.
alan_se: if we do new reservation, does customer pay double during transition?
jen_infra: billing starts when the reservation is active. we can coordinate activation time to avoid overlap — schedule creation to coincide with deactivation of the old reservation. ops can target a maintenance window.
maria_sales: customer wants zero downtime if possible. can we create a temporary route to Hosted API until Dedicated is ready?
jen_infra: yes — set a fallback policy on the service route to fallback to hosted model in the same region. that serves traffic immediately. small perf/cost delta but no outage.
chris_cust: thanks. please confirm the console link to set fallback?
alan_se: Console -> Deployments -> [service] -> Routing -> Fallback policy. can set weight to 0 for primary and 100 for hosted during migration.
maria_sales: i'll message the customer and propose a 1hr window tomorrow 13:00 CET to create new reservation and swap.
chris_cust: 13:00 CET works for us. thanks everyone :tada:
jen_infra: I'll prepare the reservation create script and watch the provision job logs. ping me on this thread when you start.
ops_bot: provision job queued for rsv-0d9e8f7g at 1792103600 (scheduled).
maria_sales: great, closing the loop — we'll execute tomorrow at 13:00 CET. thanks team!
